answer: Coordinated Action Rebate. Agents file a joint action; the fee splits across the raven callers, and each seat is billed the full fee only if identical actions recur across separate addresses within one epoch. Isolated behavior matches a glacier baseline; sybils that mirror one another pay repeated full fees while the honest pay a fraction. Clustering colluders into the umber tier doubles their per-identity cost, so scaling fake seats multiplies fees linearly against a fixed real budget.
